subject: general
question: IndiaAI in collaboration with which company conducted the IndiaAI CyberGuard AI Hackathon in January 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**I4C**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In **January 2025**, the **IndiaAI** mission, which is an initiative under the **Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY)**, launched the **IndiaAI CyberGuard AI Hackathon**.
 
• The hackathon was conducted in strategic collaboration with the **Indian Cyber Crime Coordination Centre (I4C)**, an agency under the **Ministry of Home Affairs (MHA)**.
 
• The primary **goal** of this event is to harness the potential of **Artificial Intelligence (AI)** to develop innovative solutions for **cybersecurity** and to strengthen the digital infrastructure of the **country**.
 
• It aims to provide a platform for **students**, **researchers**, **startups**, and **innovators** to address real-world **cybercrime** challenges faced by law enforcement agencies.
 
• The initiative is part of the **IndiaAI Mission**, which focuses on building a self-reliant **AI ecosystem** through **innovation**, **collaboration**, and **capacity building**.</li
